articles.title: United Airlines Experiences Temporary System Outage in the Wake of Nationwide Ground Stop
articles.summary: United Airlines has resolved a technology issue that delayed departing flights on Monday afternoon, three days after the Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop that has continued to impact flights around the country. United Airlines confirmed in a statement to TIME on Monday evening that there was a “technology issue that delayed flight departures” that had since been resolved. articles.title: A Trump, Putin, and Xi Meeting Won’t Be Yalta 2.0. But It Still Matters
articles.summary: In 1945, with Nazi Germany in its death throes, the leaders of the world’s three most powerful nations gathered in the seaside resort of Yalta. There, on the Black Sea’s pebbled shore, the Soviet Union, Great Britain, and the U.S. held negotiations that would eventually split the planet into competing spheres of influence. articles.title: Over 400 American AI Data Centers Use As Much Electricity As Wisconsin, Michigan, or Indiana
articles.summary: America’s hyperscale data centers together use as much electricity as some entire U.S. states and produce millions of metric tons of carbon dioxide over the course of a year, according to a new study published Monday in Nature Sustainability . The number of hyperscale data centers, which are larger and more powerful than traditional data centers, and are often used to train and run large-scale AI models , has exploded in recent years.
